rules.name: ParentClassToTraitsRector

examples.after:
<?php

use SilverStripe\Core\Injector\Injectable;
use SilverStripe\Core\Config\Configurable;
use SilverStripe\Core\Extensible;

class MyObject
{
    use Injectable;
    use Configurable;
    use Extensible;
}

rules.name: PropertyFetchToMethodCallRector
rules.description: Code Style: Replace specific property fetches with method calls

examples.before:
<?php

use App\Model\User;

class User
{
    public string $name;

    public function print(): void
    {
        echo $this->name;
    }
}
examples.after:
<?php

use App\Model\User;

class User
{
    public string $name;

    public function print(): void
    {
        echo $this->getName();
    }
}
